# Rego coding standards (September 2026)

This repository is an OPAL **mirror**. Do not edit `authz.rego` or add `*_test.rego` here.

Change policy in [Healthcare-Data-Exchange](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange) `policy/`, then sync with `./scripts/sync-policy-repo.sh`.
